description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Mystic Sanctuary using Venser, the Sojourner.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.
